scripts.slash:register:global: path-exists node_modules/.pnpm && node scripts/register-global-commands.js || bun scripts/register-global-commands.js
scripts.slash:register:guild: path-exists node_modules/.pnpm && node scripts/register-guild-commands.js || bun scripts/register-guild-commands.js
scripts.slash:delete:global: path-exists node_modules/.pnpm && node scripts/delete-global-commands.js || bun scripts/delete-global-commands.js
scripts.slash:delete:guild: path-exists node_modules/.pnpm && node scripts/delete-guild-commands.js || bun scripts/delete-guild-commands.js
scripts.migrate: path-exists node_modules/.pnpm && node scripts/migrate.js || bun scripts/migrate.js
scripts.generate-locale-types: path-exists node_modules/.pnpm && node scripts/generate-locale-types.js || bun scripts/generate-locale-types.js
scripts.build: (path-exists node_modules/.pnpm && pnpm run generate-locale-types || bun run generate-locale-types) && rimraf dist/ && tsdown

plugins.prepareCmd: jq --arg v "${nextRelease.version}" '.version = $v' package.json > package.json.tmp && mv package.json.tmp package.json && echo "export const version = '${nextRelease.version}'; export const buildTime = '$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")';" > dist/version.mjs && mkdir -p release && cp -r dist patches scripts locales package.json settings.example.json bun.lock pnpm-lock.yaml README.md LICENSE release/ 2>/dev/null || true && cd release && zip -r ../quaver-release.zip .
